question: Remote history and reading position across process restart

evidence.observation: thread/read exposes a separately scoped revisioned read receipt for eligible threads. It is not a viewport offset contract. Mobile compatibility remains unproved.
Native collection has distinct anchor, pinned-distance restoration, edge request and animation inputs. Algorithm and persistence remain unresolved.
Replay turn IDs, content, pending prompts and reading positions currently live only in memory.

decision: Persist the complete independent frontend replay snapshot and attachments with stable identities. Reconcile exact accepted draft identity after a crash between history commit and draft clearing. A locally interrupted replay gets an explicit replay-interruption failure and retains the source-observed error-action gate. Pending queued inputs remain available for explicit start/cancel. Persist scoped viewport positions after scrolling; restore against the same history IDs.
limitations: Snapshot format, local replay-interruption policy and viewport algorithm are independent adaptations
No real service replay/resume or backend execution
Official history/cache lifecycle and Android ownership require separate evidence

failed_probes.finding: Test incorrectly expected a generation failure to offer submission retry. Existing source-bound presentation gate rejects this. Corrected test to preserve the gate and explicitly start a saved queued input.

validation.failed_initial_assumption: Generation failure retry expectation rejected by existing source-bound gate. Test corrected.
